title: Manny's SF: 'Edgy, Inspired, and Oh-So-Well-Written' — Eric Ries with Bob Sutton
summary: Stanford professor and bestselling author Bob Sutton joins Eric for an in-person Incorruptible conversation at Manny's, San Francisco's civic gathering space. 6 PM, with Zoom option for those outside the Bay Area.
blockquote: Please join the wise and entertaining Eric Ries and me for a conversation on Thursday May 7th at Manny's in San Francisco at 6PM. We are talking about Eric's edgy, inspired, and oh-so-well-written new book "Incorruptible." On why companies go bad--but it doesn't need to be that way.
attribution_title: Stanford Professor; Author of The No Asshole Rule and Good Boss, Bad Boss
